title: Bot suspects (review)
description: Contributor logins is_bot_login() does not exclude, but that trip a weaker automation signal — one of 'automation', 'actions', 'service', 'auto', 'svc', 'ci', or 'bot' appearing as a whole segment of the login (e.g. 'hiero-automation'), never glued onto a longer word. These stay counted as people everywhere else on this dashboard; a maintainer confirming one is automation adds it to BOT_LOGINS, confirming one is a real person adds it to bot_suspect_dismissals.yaml so it stops reappearing. False positives can still happen (a login segment that just happens to be 'ci', say) but should be rare.

columns.label: Login
columns.description: The unique GitHub login identifying a contributor. Used to track all activity attributed to this person.

columns.label: Signal matched
columns.description: A weak automation signal found in the login. Triggers bot suspects review: matches patterns like 'automation', 'actions', 'service', 'auto', 'svc', 'ci', or 'bot' as a whole segment.
